allgemein.passwort_behalten: Leave empty to keep the saved password.

seite.beschreibung: Basic parameters for the job search — plans A/B/C plus search area and company size. Saved to config/suchprofile.yaml.
seite.reihenfolge: Job search order: plan A → B → C

ki.beschreibung: Which AI runs the jobs you start from a button or the Task Centre. With ChatGPT, BMS runs on your ChatGPT subscription; you sign in from the terminal with codex login. The data from AI runs then goes to OpenAI instead of Anthropic. ChatGPT is a preview. After switching, “AI model per function” shows the models of the chosen provider.
ki.status_fehler: The status of the AI programs could not be loaded.

modelle.beschreibung: Applies to runs started from a button or the Task Centre. Default: {{standard}}.

portale.beschreibung: The daily run only searches active portals. The ones common in Germany are preset — you can change the name and URL, and two rows are free for other portals. If you are searching outside Germany, use your own portals in these rows, LinkedIn alerts and your target companies.

unterlagen.beschreibung: Sets the default for the tick box on the job page; you can override it for each job at any time. The Advisory Board check is a separate, optional step, not a link in the chain.

beirat.beschreibung: The seven members are fictional archetypes, not real people. The actual persona text (school of thought, probing questions, limits) is created only through “Replace” in a run — here you only edit the display name, short perspective, colour and chair. There are always exactly seven seats: voting in the job check is calibrated for seven votes.
beirat.neu_hinweis: Name and perspective (1–2 sentences) for the new member — the run creates the full persona text, not this field.
beirat.name: Name
beirat.lauf_gestartet: ✓ Run started — follow its progress in the Task Centre.

mail.beschreibung: Nothing is ever sent automatically — BMS only reads mail and saves drafts in the folder you choose. The recommended default is IMAP with an app password from your provider (not your normal account password) — this works for Gmail too. The Gmail API is the power option with full search syntax and needs your own Google Cloud project. Outlook.com/Microsoft accounts are currently not supported because they lack IMAP basic auth. Step by step: docs/SETUP-EMAIL.md.
mail.imap: IMAP (Gmail, GMX, Web.de, mailbox.org, Posteo, iCloud Mail, …)

beispieldaten.nicht_entfernt: These files were not removed because you changed them or they are in use:
beispieldaten.beschreibung: This installation contains sample data for {{name}} to try out: {{zaehlung}}, plus a profile, career history and a CV. Remove it before you enter your own data. BMS creates a backup first. Your own entries are kept.
beispieldaten.frage: Remove the sample data now? BMS backs up your database first.

coach.beschreibung: Password-protected read-only mirror for your coach: overview, active applications AND screening/review (New + To review) — each job with company fit, match and job posting (without internal capture context) — plus rejections with reasons. No emails, notes, Advisory Board checks, salaries or transcripts. Updates automatically at the end of the daily run — or right here, right now. Step by step: docs/ANLEITUNG_COACH_SITE.md.
coach.beschreibung_mit_adresse: Password-protected read-only mirror for your coach at {{adresse}}: overview, active applications AND screening/review (New + To review) — each job with company fit, match and job posting (without internal capture context) — plus rejections with reasons. No emails, notes, Advisory Board checks, salaries or transcripts. Updates automatically at the end of the daily run — or right here, right now. Step by step: docs/ANLEITUNG_COACH_SITE.md.
coach.serverpfad: Server path to the access file

coach.login_hinweis: Your coach uses this to sign in to the site.

sicherung.beschreibung: BMS backs up your database once a day as a ZIP file while it is running. It removes older automatic backups according to the retention rule.
sicherung.status_fehler: The backup status could not be loaded.
sicherung.weitere_one: Plus {{count}} more backup directly in data/backups ({{groesse}}). BMS never removes these.
sicherung.weitere_other: Plus {{count}} more backups directly in data/backups ({{groesse}}). BMS never removes these.
sicherung.zurueckspielen: Restoring: quit BMS, then double-click wiederherstellen.command (Mac) or wiederherstellen_windows.bat (Windows). The steps are in the guide under “Backup”.

version.fehler: The version could not be loaded.
version.entwicklung: Development installation: updates come through Git.
version.vor_einspielen: Before installing, the update backs up the database and any files it replaces.
version.schritt_update: In the program folder ({{ordner}}), double-click {{datei}}. It downloads the new version from GitHub by itself; follow the instructions.
version.ohne_internet: Without internet: put the file BMS_<Version>.zip from the GitHub page into your Downloads folder, then do step 2.

update.hinweis: Asks GitHub for the latest version. GitHub receives this computer's IP address.
